wintercity_e18_entry.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e18_entry.text: On Day 934, Yue collected eighteen copper for the seasonal public week on Days 928, 930, and 932. wintercity_e18_001.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e18_001.text: The independent inspection custodian sent an actual reply to the source request. wintercity_e18_005.speaker: narrator

wintercity_e18_007.text: A caller asked why a seat could be physically safe and still fall outside an accepted heating promise. wintercity_e18_008.speaker: narrator

wintercity_e18_source_public_002.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e18_source_public_002.text: The authorized maker summary could accompany Yue's particular hearing role only within that role's current mandate. wintercity_source_closed.text: Yue paid four copper for the bounded qualified comparison and one for accepted sealed custody preparation on Day 938.
